description: Land Acquisition - Wilpita, Athuraliya D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister of Lands that a specific parcel of land is needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land location, boundaries, and extent. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters. While it mentions a government minister, the core content is specifically about land acquisition rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
